# Coder Social

> > A collaborative hub for discovering and exploring open-source JavaScript libraries, frameworks, and developer projects with curated documentation and community resources.

Coder Social aggregates information about popular open-source projects, developer profiles, and learning resources, with a strong focus on React, TypeScript, and web development tools. The platform serves as a discovery engine for developers seeking libraries, design systems, and educational materials from organizations like Meta, GitHub, and community-driven initiatives.

## Key Topics

- React
- JavaScript
- TypeScript
- GitHub
- Node.js
- Redux
- Ant Design
- Frontend Development
- Open-Source Projects
- UI Components
- Web Development
- React Native
- Webpack
- Developer Tools
- React Documentation

## Core React Libraries & Frameworks

- [Git Product Home](https://coder.social): React search and repository listing hub for JavaScript libraries.
- [React by Facebook](https://coder.social/facebook/react): React library for web and native user interfaces by Facebook.
- [Primer React Component Library](https://coder.social/primer/react): Primer React component library implementing GitHub's design system.
- [React Admin Dashboard Template](https://coder.social/duxianwei520/react): React admin dashboard template with Redux, Webpack, and Ant Design.
- [Enterprise React Admin Framework](https://coder.social/react-redux-antd-es6/react): Enterprise React admin framework with Redux and Ant Design UI.
- [ReAct Framework for Language Models](https://coder.social/ysymyth/react): ReAct framework synergizing reasoning and acting in language models.

## Design Systems & UI Components

- [GitHub Primer Design System](https://coder.social/primer): GitHub's Primer design system with components and design guidelines.
- [Meta Open Source Organization](https://coder.social/facebook): Meta's open source organization page showcasing projects and tools.

## TypeScript & Developer Resources

- [TypeScript Cheatsheets](https://coder.social/typescript-cheatsheets): Community curated TypeScript cheatsheets and recipes for developers.
- [React TypeScript Cheatsheet](https://coder.social/typescript-cheatsheets/react): React TypeScript cheatsheet guide for experienced developers.
- [React Documentation in Chinese](https://coder.social/discountry/react): React documentation translated to Chinese by community contributor.

## Educational & Community Programs

- [HackYourFuture Bootcamp](https://coder.social/hackyourfuture): HackYourFuture bootcamp organization for refugee web development.
- [HackYourFuture React Curriculum](https://coder.social/hackyourfuture/react): HackYourFuture React module curriculum for building dynamic UIs.
